title: Hotel
description: Hotel accommodation with location, star rating, contact information, pricing, amenities, room count, and customer ratings. Used for hotel booking platforms, travel agencies, and accommodation services.

description.description: Detailed description of the hotel, facilities, and services

city.description: City where the hotel is located

country.description: Country where the hotel is located

latitude.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the hotel

longitude.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the hotel

rating.description: Average customer rating, typically on a scale of 1-5

price_per_night.description: Price per night for a standard room

currency.description: ISO currency code for the price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

rooms.description: Total number of rooms available in the hotel

amenities.description: List of hotel amenities (e.g., WiFi, Pool, Gym, Spa, Restaurant)

image.description: URL to the hotel's main image or photo
